title: OptionsSnapshot - point-in-time option context
description: MRBS OPT-002 made executable: a snapshot without timestamp, model version or a per-series underlying is Unusable, and the schema refuses to represent one as Ready. Encodes the two hard facts from ADR-004 - identity is vendor-verified, open interest is client-blocked.

snapshotTimeUtc.description: OPT-002: point-in-time is mandatory. A snapshot with no time is Unusable, never merely stale.

modelVersion.description: OPT-002 requires the model version alongside the data.

futuresContextSymbol.description: The futures contract the ANALYSIS is anchored on, e.g. GCZ6.

productCode.description: Load-bearing. Product ECG10 ('Event Contracts on Gold Futures') passes instrument-type, underlying, strike, put/call and expiry checks and is still the wrong instrument family - point value 1.0 against 100.0 and strikes on a 10x scale. Only productCode and point value separate them.

underlyingSymbol.description: READ from vendor reference data, per series. Measured: OGU6 -> GCV6 while the futures front month is GCZ6. Never inferred, never assumed to be the front month (MRBS ROLL-004).

singlePointValue.description: Measured 100.0 for standard GC options; 1.0 identifies an event contract.

identitySource.description: Constrained to one value on purpose: parsing identity out of the symbol string is not permitted, so the schema cannot express it.

openInterest.description: Null while template 158 is client-blocked. Present only when openInterestStatus is SCHEMA_BOUND.

openInterestStatus.description: Vendor sends OI on template 158 - decoded off the wire as OGU6 C4120 = 174, C4035 = 42 - but async_rithmic 1.6.3 has no message class and discards it (ADR-004, ADR-007).

then.description: An OI value may only exist when its frame is schema-bound. A field-number-only decode is archival, not a value (ADR-007).

derivedExposure.description: GEX and dealer positioning. Null is the correct value today: OPT-004 requires formula, sign and assumption to be recorded, and OI is blocked, so no honest exposure figure exists. KDK section 50 stands regardless - GEX is a module inside the Options pillar and never a necessary condition.

then.description: Ready requires every contract to carry a schema-bound open interest. With template 158 blocked this branch is currently unsatisfiable - which is the intended outcome, not an oversight: it makes 'Options Ready' impossible to assert while the client discards OI.
MRBS ROLL-004: wrong underlying mapping forces Options Invalid and the CONTRACT_MAPPING_INVALID reason code.
If exposure is present at all, optionsState must not claim Ready without bound OI, and OPT-004's four fields are already required by the sub-schema.
